correctness.rationale: The proof identifies the published complex with a quotient of the standard Freudenthal triangulation by the explicit index-15 deck lattice, so integral first homology is that lattice. The verifier reconstructs all 90 tetrahedra and 180 triangles, checks deck displacement is zero on every face, exhausts all 275 missing triangles, verifies every class is nonzero and primitive, and independently recovers first Betti number 3 over four characteristics. It also regenerates the order-120 automorphism group and exhausts all cycle and class orbits.

value.rationale: The Kühnel--Lassmann complex is a classical highly symmetric small triangulation of the three-torus. The shortest integral-homology cycles are a natural combinatorial systolic invariant, and the result completely classifies them rather than sampling a parameter slice. The exceptional five-cycle class and the 1+2+4 symmetry decomposition expose genuine structure in how the finite triangulation represents the infinite lattice of torus homology directions.
